projectionYearsComment: Five years is used because the business is still scaling but visibility beyond five years is limited.

wacc.comment: Blended discount rate used for DCF.
wacc.explanation: Assume 4.5% risk-free rate, 1.15 beta, 5.5% equity risk premium, after-tax cost of debt 5.8%, and target capital structure of 75% equity / 25% debt.

terminalGrowth.comment: Long-term growth aligned with inflation and mature GDP-like growth.

peMultiple.comment: Reference P/E multiple based on peer set.

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.comment: Top-line growth declines gradually as the company matures.

costOfRevenue.label: Cost of Revenue
costOfRevenue.comment: Cost growth remains below revenue growth due to scale.

gaExpense.label: General & Administrative Expense
gaExpense.comment: G&A grows slower than revenue as operating leverage improves.

interestCost.label: Interest Cost
interestCost.comment: Interest cost trends down as debt amortizes.

workingCapitalMovement.label: Working Capital Movement
workingCapitalMovement.comment: Working capital investment rises with scale.
